# Upstream source

`magic_mapper.py` is an unmodified, pinned copy of
[andrewfraley/magic_mapper](https://github.com/andrewfraley/magic_mapper).
The exact commit and checksum are recorded in `upstream.json`.

Run `npm run sync-upstream` to fetch and verify the pinned source. The app's
lifecycle, discovery, state reporting, and UI live outside this directory.
